name: Acceptance voice mode
description: The acceptance run's second speaking plugin, installed from a folder: it speaks through a background part of its own, which takes the device's speech turn (device/speech) before it sounds, so it never talks over Clover Voice. It fills the platform's voiceModes (one at a time: picked in Settings it is the active voice; it doesn't listen) and offers its reply on Clover Voice's modes point: picked, it says each reply its own way (a tone). Its commands: `chime` has its part play a short tone, `report` says what it said and when it held the turn.

commands.name: chime
commands.description: Has its background part play a short tone, in the device's speech turn.

commands.name: report
commands.description: What it said, and the spans its part held the device's speech turn.
